about: Write a Related Work section to a spec: three given citations, a booktabs table with caption and label, referenced from the text; it must compile with every citation resolved.
prompt: In the LaTeX project at {project} (main file main.tex), add a section titled "Related Work" between the Introduction and the Method sections. It must cite all three of these entries from references.bib: lamport1994, mittelbach2004 and oetiker2023, and it must include a table built with booktabs rules (\toprule, \midrule, \bottomrule) that compares the three works, with a \caption and a \label that the section's text references. Do not change references.bib. The document must compile with no errors and no undefined citations or references: use the maleficium MCP server to compile and check it, and edit files with your own file tools.
